formulations.Polymer system Notes: PEO and lithium salts (LiI, LiClO4, and LiCF3SO3) based composite polymer electrolytes have been prepared for different [EO]/[Li] ratio using solution casting method and characterized by x-ray diffraction (XRD-), scanning electron microscope, and differential scanning calorimetry (DSC-). The electrical measurements have been carried out at different temperatures.
formulations.Arrhenius notes: Conductivity follows Arrhenius relation; activation energy is very large due to slow hopping processes arising from strong coupling between mobile cations and polymer backbone.
formulations.Notes: PEO (MW= 400 000, Aldrich- and appropriate amount of vacuum dried anhydrous LiI/LiClO4/LiCF3SO3 (Aldrich- were dissolved in acetonitrile under stirring condition. After stirring for 8–10 h at room temperature, the solutions became very thick due to solvent evaporation. Finally, they were cast in PTFE containers and dried in vacuum (at a pressure 0.01 mbar- at 60 °C for 36 h to form the homogeneous free standing films. Good free standing films were obtained for [EO] / [Li] = 9, 12, 15, and 18.
